decisions.reason: Fully connects bare top-level ESM import in the plugin bundle to the once-per-boot classic-script combo: one parse error prevents the whole unit from executing, no entries register, and the named typert-registry entry is identified as the first awaited roster victim, with no claim that ESM is invalid everywhere.

Bisects the profile patch rows and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) contract (package-name identity, host React via require, apply/inject exports), but its classic-script parse check is node --check plus grep — the rubric explicitly deems node --check alone insufficient (it can accept ESM) and no vm.Script-equivalent parse is used.

Uses the apply error to explain that the settings shell owns the declaration, that cross-entry apply order is unconstrained, and gives the exact deferred form ctx.slots.inject("settings.section", () => ctx.slots.register({name, id, order, label}, C)) while forbidding kind/scope on registrants.

Explains the combo is composed once at boot so refreshes refetch stale bytes, prescribes full host stop/restart with port verification, taskkill /PID /T /F tree kill, hard refresh and plugin-list/artifact verification, and attributes EADDRINUSE to the surviving old process, not the plugin.

Proposes per-entry vm.Script classic-script validation and combo-failure attribution instead of blaming the first awaited entry, plus a template/checklist covering the loader factory, host React, apply/inject, deferred ctx.slots.inject for cross-entry slots, and restart/Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: Affirmative advice mandates the classic wrapper, ctx.slots.inject deferral, no kind/scope on registrants, and full host restarts; watch/recompose appears only as an optional host-side improvement, never as a substitute for restarting.
